tasks.title: Freeze P2 deferred-frontier authority
tasks.objective: Bind P2 scope exactly to the 314 volumes explicitly deferred by the terminal P1 execution map and fail closed on loss, duplication, or scope inflation.
acceptance: P2 source scope equals the P1 deferred-volume set exactly.
Scheduled and queued P2 volume sets are disjoint and their union equals the P2 source scope.
Every scheduled primary volume has exactly one task owner.
Task dependencies are known, acyclic, and cannot self-reference.

tasks.title: Converge architecture and contract authority
tasks.objective: Make architecture ownership, canonical contracts, import/package boundaries, manifests, ADRs, and fitness rules mutually consistent and machine-verifiable.
acceptance: Canonical owner and import boundaries are machine-checkable.
Schema/contract drift fails closed instead of being tolerated as documentation debt.
Architecture waivers and ADR exceptions are explicit, bounded, and reviewable.

tasks.title: Build requirements-to-runtime traceability spine
tasks.objective: Create a canonical graph linking requirements, capabilities, behavior/state contracts, schemas, compatibility rules, producers/consumers, tests, and evidence.
acceptance: Every scheduled contract has a canonical owner, version, compatibility rule, and test/evidence edge.
Dangling trace edges and unknown schema/state references fail closed.
Maturity remains derived from evidence rather than hand-edited status.

tasks.title: Operationalize autonomous repository engineering
tasks.objective: Connect code intelligence, backlog/priority control, work packages, anti-patterns, build ordering, debt, roadmap, and completion rollups into one deterministic repository-engineering control plane.
acceptance: Repository change planning derives ownership, dependency, test, and evidence impact from canonical data.
Priority control prevents blocker starvation and cannot game completion percentages.
Destructive or autonomous mutation remains transactional, bounded, and independently verifiable.

tasks.title: Strengthen formal quality and final assembly qualification
tasks.objective: Bind quality vectors, formal-method candidates, project metrics, and final assembly acceptance to non-compensable gates and reproducible evidence.
acceptance: Aggregate quality metrics cannot hide a failed non-compensable dimension.
Formal checks are scoped to executable targets with model-to-code traceability.
Final assembly evidence is exact-head and environment-bound.

tasks.title: Make generated documentation evidence-bound
tasks.objective: Generate human documentation from canonical machine authority while detecting stale, hand-divergent, or unreviewable generated output.
acceptance: Generated documentation declares its machine sources and content identity.
Regeneration is deterministic and clean-tree checked.
Generated prose cannot override machine/runtime authority.

tasks.title: Profile-gate native and JVM acceleration
tasks.objective: Select native/JVM acceleration only where profiling evidence justifies complexity, with ABI/protocol isolation and regression evidence.
acceptance: Acceleration targets are selected from reproducible profiles.
ABI/protocol compatibility and crash isolation are explicit.
Fallback behavior preserves correctness when accelerators are unavailable.
